rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the shell-bearing animal.

example.english: I saw a snail in the park.
example.traditional: 我喺公園見到一隻蝸牛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 gung1 jyun2 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 wo1 ngau4

rows.note: Use this for a person who habitually does things slowly.

example.english: You’re such a snail; you’re always the last to arrive.
example.traditional: 你真係個慢郎中，成日最後一個先到。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 go3 maan6 long4 zung1 seng4 jat6 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 go3 sin1 dou3
